Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Positive = good change, Negative = bad change. For costs, debt or churn flip the mapping: a rise is Negative.
One decimal with a comma: +12,4% · −3,1%.
Always pair with the comparison period (“vs last week”).
Spec
